facts.fact: Newzroom dot Africa reports that Teraco runs a 110MW campus in Isando, Johannesburg, and more than 200MW across its sites, connecting customers directly to cloud providers.
Newzroom dot Africa reports that Google has a region in Johannesburg, Microsoft Azure has South Africa North and South Africa West regions, and Amazon Web Services has a region in Cape Town.
facts.system: Google Johannesburg, Azure South Africa North and West, AWS Cape Town regions
